findings.issue: Length check uses >=, so a trimmed query of exactly 100 characters is rejected. The spec allows 100.
findings.refuter_reason: A trimmed query of exactly 100 characters throws SearchValidationError, but AC4 says exactly 100 is allowed.

findings.issue: The author clause interpolates the raw trimmed query into the SQL string (SQL injection; quote causes 500; % and _ act as wildcards).
findings.evidence: book.ts:34 `author LIKE '%${trimmed}%'` with only the title clause bound.
findings.refuter_reason: Template-string SQL violates AC5 and the project rule; a quote breaks the SQL and % and _ act as wildcards on author.

findings.issue: /api/books/search is registered after /books/:id, so 'search' is matched as an id and the alias never reaches the search handler.
findings.refuter_reason: /api/books/search is handled by /books/:id, which parses 'search' as NaN; the spec requires the alias first.

findings.issue: Author is output unescaped with <%- , allowing stored XSS.
findings.refuter_reason: Unescaped output of a DB value; the spec and project rules require <%= %>.

findings.issue: Vacuous author-match assertion: length > 0 does not show the author match works.
findings.evidence: expect(res.body.length).toBeGreaterThan(0) for q=Herbert; no exact count or title check.
findings.refuter_reason: The test would pass even if the author clause were broken or too broad.

findings.issue: On the HTMX endpoint an empty or missing q returns no books instead of all books.
findings.refuter_reason: A missing or empty q renders 'No books found.' instead of all books; AC2 says empty query returns all.

findings.issue: The required tests/models/book-search.test.ts is missing; route tests miss boundary, alias, literal, escaping and repeated-q cases.
findings.refuter_reason: SPEC.md requires the model test file; this is the umbrella finding for the coverage gaps (T2-T7).
